title: SpectralAnalysisEngine and AnalysisFifo — shared STFT, background thread, multi-consumer
description:
Implement the SINGLE shared spectral analysis subsystem: AnalysisFifo plus SpectralAnalysisEngine with Hann-window STFT, configurable FFT size/hop, background worker thread, multi-consumer read APIs, overload skip-frames, and fixed memory bounds per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §8.2 and §18.3.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §8.2 (STFT Hann frame, S_t[k] = 20*log10(|X|+eps), local baseline / excess prep inputs)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §12.1–12.4 (instant spectrum, percentile cloud, persistence map — later consumers of this engine; design multi-consumer snapshots now)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §18.1 and §18.3 (audio-thread rules; AbstractFifo; skip frames when overloaded; fixed memory; stop heavy work when disabled)
- Source/DSP/PitchDetector.* FIFO / control-rate thread patterns from phase F (read only; do not rewrite pitch)
- Sibling DSP modules under Source/DSP/* and any existing Source/Analysis/* for prepare/reset style (read only)
- CMakeLists.txt (read only; g.3 owns CMake registration)

Implement Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.h and Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.cpp:
1. Fixed-capacity SPSC (or multi-producer-safe only if documented) audio ring using juce::AbstractFifo or equivalent.
2. prepare(capacitySamples, numChannels) allocates once; push from audio thread copies interleaved or planar frames without heap; pop/read for analysis thread advances read pointer without blocking the audio producer.
3. Overrun policy: drop oldest or newest frames (document choice) — never block or allocate; expose dropped-frame counters atomically for diagnostics.
4. Channel layout: at least mono downmix helper and stereo L/R storage hooks for pre-EQ / optional sidechain tap capacity (storage only; wiring later).

Implement Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.h and Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.cpp:
1. SpectralAnalysisEngine is the sole STFT owner for resonance detector, future percentile cloud, spectrum display, persistence map, and sidechain collision analysis. Document multi-consumer snapshot contracts in the header.
2. prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize, fftOrderOrSize): preallocate Hann window, FFT (juce::dsp::FFT or equivalent project style), magnitude/log-magnitude working buffers, hop accumulator. No FFT planning / allocation on the audio path thereafter.
3. STFT per §8.2: X_t[k] via windowed hop; S_t[k] = 20*log10(|X_t[k]| + epsilon). Configurable FFT size and hop at prepare (or setConfig applied off audio thread with bounded double-buffer if needed).
4. Background thread (juce::Thread / TimeSliceClient owned by the engine): pull from AnalysisFifo, compute frames; when overloaded, skip frames rather than stall audio; when setEnabled(false) or consumers idle, idle the worker with near-zero CPU.
5. Audio-thread API: pushAudio(const float* const* channels, int numChannels, int numSamples) — copy only into FIFO; no mutex waits, no FFT, no heap.
6. Multi-consumer read API: lock-free or briefly consistent snapshot of latest magnitude / log-magnitude spectrum, frame timestamp/sequence, FFT size, sample rate, bin-to-Hz helper. Snapshot must be safe for a control/GUI/analysis consumer without blocking processBlock.
7. Fixed memory bounds: no unbounded history in this task (history windows belong to later analyzer phases). Optional small latest-N ring only if capacity is fixed at prepare and documented.
8. Numerical guards: epsilon floors, finite checks on magnitudes, valid Nyquist bin counts after sample-rate changes (re-prepare path).
9. No ResonanceDetector, ResonanceSuppressor, PluginProcessor wiring, tests, or CMakeLists changes in this task.

C++20/JUCE style consistent with Source/. verification_commands left empty — C++ adapter infers cmake/ctest.
acceptance_criteria: AnalysisFifo uses fixed-capacity juce::AbstractFifo (or equivalent) with audio-thread push that never heap-allocates or blocks
SpectralAnalysisEngine computes Hann-window STFT and S_t[k] = 20*log10(|X|+eps) with configurable FFT size and hop per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §8.2
Background worker pulls FIFO frames and skips frames when overloaded; disabled/idle path stops expensive FFT work per §18.3
Multi-consumer snapshot API exposes latest spectrum (magnitude or log-magnitude), sequence/timestamp, and bin frequency mapping without audio-thread locks
Memory for FFT/window/fifos is bounded at prepare; no unbounded spectral history
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add third-party FFT libraries as new dependencies
implement resonance candidate scoring or suppressor notches
wire processBlock ownership of the analyzer thread from PluginProcessor

allowed: juce::AbstractFifo + fixed float storage for AnalysisFifo
engine-owned juce::Thread or TimeSliceClient for STFT worker
lock-free double-buffered spectrum snapshot for multi-consumer reads
mono downmix of multi-channel push for primary analysis path
